boundary.meaning: Source-review recommendations and isolated comparison arms, not merit winners or new-host acceptance.
boundary.default_profile: Minimal native foundation only: existing bootstrap component_ids [codex, claude-code], implicit Node/uv/gh pins, and CPython 3.13.15 via uv; Git and OS utilities are prerequisites.
boundary.install_dispatch: Do not iterate over entries. The existing bootstrap installs only the named native profile and its implicit toolchain; every optional row and comparison arm is excluded. Examples are not an authorization to install.

blocking_gaps: The native bootstrap has no documented --dry-run option at this source revision; no installation was executed. Supported per-step dry runs are recorded separately.

boundary.position_semantics: Stage and position are reproducible presentation/dependency order, not ranking or default precedence. Arms are provisioned only in isolated, preregistered comparisons.

comparison_dependencies.reason: The one model server must support the selected code-RAG arm's embedding provider.
One engine owner in hosting-services; isolation owns only the boundary comparison.

boundary.owner_rule: Each named tool/control appears once in its owning layer. Other layers retain uses, not duplicate installs or independent ownership.

uses: the native subagents of Claude Code and Codex (native-clients)
the local model server for embeddings (observation-inference)
the local model server for Hindsight's local-model arm (observation-inference)

boundary.runtime_ownership: recovery-portability retains mise's reproduction ownership and owns the runtime entries. uv supplies CPython 3.13.15 and package/lock operations by the user's explicit requirement; the existing native bootstrap supplies the pinned Node archive. This retains one layer owner per executable and does not install mise by default.

operating_systems.reason: Published checksums do not decide WSL, systemd, toolchain or GPU acceptance; no distro creation/global WSL change.

paid_services.reason: No paid service, provider, account or deployment was selected/authorized by this source artifact; task-specific decisions and native sign-ins remain with their owners.
